candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from payment authorization calls timing out: gateway traces show POST payment to /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory reservations succeed, propagating 502 up through order and checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side metrics/logs excluded; whether payment is slow or unreachable is unconfirmed. Redis and inventory appear healthy.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment authorization ReadTimeouts (~2s) causing 502s on order and checkout, while inventory/redis succeed. Metrics confirm checkout 502s and ~2.4s p95. Payment-side evidence is missing to fully bound the cause.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment is the slow dependency
Payment service logs to distinguish timeout vs connection refusal
